test_title: SSC Stenographer 2023 Official Paper (Held On: 13 Oct, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

There was utter _________ after the explosion.
solution:
The correct answer is** Option (3)** i.e.** 'mayhem'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Mayhem (अराजकता)** - Violent or damaging disorder; chaos.

 
 
• **Example: **The strikes caused ***mayhem ***in the city's transportation system.
 
 
 
• From the example it is clear the the given sentence means that there was complete disorder and chaos after the explosion occurred.
 
• Hence, 'mayhem' is the most appropriate word to fill in the blank.

Therefore, the complete sentence is *There was utter mayhem __after the explosion. *

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Pacifism (अहिंसा) **- The belief in peace and refusing to fight in wars.

 
 
• **Example: **Gandhi's philosophy was grounded in pacifism and non-violence.
 
 
 
• **Belting (कसना / बेल्ट चढ़ाना)** - Fastening with a belt or striking forcefully.
 
 
• **Example: **He was belting out songs on the stage performance.
 
 
 
• **Force (बल)** - Strength or energy as an attribute of physical action or movement.
 
 
• **Example:** He opened the jammed door with a great force.
